# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the EMA ribbon expands (showing increasing momentum), a pullback to VWAP that closes with a bullish candle offers a high‑probability long entry. This edge exists because ribbon expansion signals strengthening bullish momentum, while a VWAP pullback with a bullish close indicates institutional buying interest during intraday retracements, creating a high-probability continuation setup.

## Mechanism

Calculate 9, 20, and 50-period EMAs. Ribbon expansion triggers when (EMA9 - EMA50) > 0.5 * ATR(14) AND EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50. Wait for price to touch VWAP (within 0.1% of VWAP) and close above VWAP with a bullish candle (close > open AND close > previous close) within the first 90 minutes of session (09:30-11:00 ET). Enter long at the close of that candle. Exit: initial stop at the low of the expansion candle (or recent swing low whichever is lower). Target 1: take profit at 1.5R. Runner: trail stop at 10% below highest high since entry (HWM). Avoid trades during major news releases (FOMC, CPI) or when VIX > 30; optimal when VIX < 20.
